# Sleep Event

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Recording metrics from overnight sleep.

## Scope note

- Capture information from Sleep Cycle and Apple Health apps.

## Broader

- [Health Event](../HealthEvent/) — generic (ISO 25964)
